types.name: ConfirmMorphState
types.doc: Where the control is in its life: resting, asking, working, finished, or failed.

types.name: ConfirmMorphMode
types.doc: How the question is answered: a press, a press held until the fill completes, or a press followed by a short countdown.

types.name: ConfirmMorphProps
types.doc: A button for destructive or important actions that asks in place. Pressing it morphs the same pill into an inline question with Cancel and Confirm, then into a spinner, then into a result with Undo. The width springs to each face while the faces crossfade at their natural width, so text never squashes and nothing around the control jumps. Escape, an outside press, or the timeout all return it to rest. Use it where a modal dialog would be heavy: deleting a project, revoking access, discarding a draft.

members.name: label
members.doc: The resting label, such as "Delete project".

members.name: icon
members.doc: A plain icon before the resting label.

members.name: prompt
members.doc: The question shown while confirming, such as "Delete 3 files?". Defaults to the label with a question mark.

members.name: pendingLabel
members.doc: Shown beside the spinner while `onConfirm` resolves.

members.name: undoingLabel
members.doc: Shown beside the spinner while `onUndo` resolves.

members.name: tone
members.doc: `danger` (default) gives the confirm button the danger colour, for actions that destroy something. `neutral` gives it the accent, for important actions that can be reversed. The resting button is neutral either way.

members.name: confirmMode
members.doc: `press` confirms on a press. `hold` asks for a press held for `holdDuration`. `countdown` confirms, then counts down `countdown` seconds that Cancel or Escape can still stop.

members.name: holdDuration
members.doc: Milliseconds the confirm button must be held in `hold` mode.

members.name: countdown
members.doc: Seconds counted down before the action runs in `countdown` mode.

members.name: countdownLabel
members.doc: Text before the seconds in `countdown` mode, such as "Deleting in". Defaults to the pending label followed by "in".

members.name: onConfirm
members.doc: Runs on confirm. Return a promise to show the pending face; a rejection shows the error face with Retry.

members.name: onUndo
members.doc: Offering it adds Undo to the result. Return a promise to show a pending face while it runs.

members.name: confirmTimeout
members.doc: Milliseconds before an unanswered question returns to rest. Resting the pointer on the control pauses it. 0 turns it off.

members.name: resultTimeout
members.doc: Milliseconds a result stays before returning to rest. Resting the pointer on the control pauses it. 0 turns it off.

members.name: cancelOnOutsidePress
members.doc: A press outside the control cancels an open question. Defaults to true.

members.name: ref
members.doc: Receives the root element, which also takes focus while the action is pending.
